entries.en: Added `$.ui.selection()` for mods: returns the text you last selected in fullscreen mode and, when the selection lies within one transcript row, that row
entries.zh: 为 mods 添加了 `$.ui.selection()`：返回您最后在全屏模式下选择的文本，并且当选择位于一个记录行内时，返回该行

entries.en: Added a built-in `gh api` to cloud sessions whose image has no GitHub CLI, and fixed the built-in sending control characters from file names, jq filters or GitHub errors to the terminal
entries.zh: 为镜像没有 GitHub CLI 的云会话添加了内置的`gh api`，并修复了从文件名、jq 过滤器或 GitHub 错误到终端的内置发送控制字符的问题

entries.en: Added recovery for a prompt cleared with Ctrl+C: pressing Up on the empty prompt brings the draft back, including pasted text and images
entries.zh: 添加了对使用 Ctrl+C 清除的提示的恢复：在空提示上按向上键可恢复草稿，包括粘贴的文本和图像

entries.en: Added a re-authenticate prompt when an MCP server asks for more OAuth scope during a tool call
entries.zh: 当 MCP 服务器在工具调用期间请求更多 OAuth 范围时添加了重新身份验证提示

entries.en: Added `--max-findings <n>|all` to /code-review to report more or fewer findings than the usual limit; the choice is reused until you pass `--max-findings default`
entries.zh: 在 /code-review 中添加了 `--max-findings <n>|all` 以报告比通常限制更多或更少的发现；该选择将被重复使用，直到您通过`--max-findings default`

entries.en: Added Ctrl+F to find a session by name and Alt+↑/↓ to jump between groups in the agents view; both, and rename, can be rebound in keybindings.json
entries.zh: 添加了 Ctrl+F 按名称查找会话和 Alt+↑/↓ 在代理视图中的组之间跳转；两者和重命名都可以在 keybindings.json 中反弹

entries.en: Added a screen reader mode announcement of the new permission mode when you approve a plan, including with Shift+Tab
entries.zh: 添加了批准计划时新权限模式的屏幕阅读器模式公告，包括使用 Shift+Tab

entries.en: Improved auto mode: when a conversation grows too long for the client-side safety classifier to review, it is now compacted instead of prompting for, or failing, every tool call
entries.zh: 改进自动模式：对话长到客户端安全分类器无法审查时，会先压缩，而不是对每个工具调用都弹窗询问或直接失败

entries.en: Improved screen reader mode: short announcements, such as a deleted word, now stay on screen until your next key press or until something above them on screen changes
entries.zh: 改进屏幕阅读器模式：简短提示（如删除了一个词）会一直停留在屏幕上，直到你按下下一个键，或其上方内容发生变化

entries.en: Improved screen reader mode: answered questions in question dialogs now say "answered" beside their box
entries.zh: 改进屏幕阅读器模式：问题对话框中已回答的问题，框旁会显示「answered」

entries.en: Improved the `/usage-credits` message shown to Team and Enterprise members whose organization has turned off usage credit requests
entries.zh: 改进 `/usage-credits` 提示：对于所在组织已关闭用量积分申请的 Team 和 Enterprise 成员，会显示相应说明

entries.en: Improved cloud sessions: a new conversation's first turn no longer waits for a stdio MCP server whose config sets `alwaysLoad: false`
entries.zh: 改进云会话：`alwaysLoad: false` 的 stdio MCP 服务器尚未就绪时，新对话的第一轮不再等待它

entries.en: Improved "You should know" notes to say "we", "the main agent" or "you" depending on who was responsible for a decision
entries.zh: 改进“You should know”提示的措辞：根据决定是谁做的，改用“我们”、“主代理”或“你”

entries.en: Improved the error for an artifact database write refused at the database's size limit: it now states the limit and what frees space
entries.zh: 改进 Artifact 数据库写入因达到大小上限被拒绝时的报错：会说明上限是多少，以及什么可以释放空间

entries.en: Improved Bash permission prompts to give a shorter reason when part of a command can't be checked before it runs
entries.zh: 改进 Bash 权限弹窗：命令中有部分内容无法在运行前检查时，给出更简短的理由

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Improved the built-in `gh api`: a refused gh command now prints its `gh api` equivalent, `--paginate` follows every page of a repository's lists, and a nested `claude` no longer removes it
entries.zh: 改进了内置的 `gh api`：被拒绝的 gh 命令会打印其等效的 `gh api` 写法，`--paginate` 会翻完仓库列表的每一页，嵌套的 `claude` 也不再移除它

entries.en: Improved Remote Control's recovery from an expired server credential: sessions stay connected during renewal and are kept if it gives up after a server outage
entries.zh: 改进远程控制对过期服务端凭证的恢复：续期期间会话保持连接；即使服务器故障后放弃续期，会话也会保留

entries.en: Changed the background command time limit to apply only in unattended sessions (`-p`, Agent SDK, CI, cloud); terminal, desktop app and VS Code sessions have no limit
entries.zh: 更改了后台命令时间限制，使其仅适用于无人值守会话（`-p`、Agent SDK、CI、云）；终端、桌面应用程序和 VS Code 会话没有限制

entries.en: Changed the client-side auto mode classifier to ignore an `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL` pin that names Claude Sonnet 5.5 or Opus 5.5 and use Claude Sonnet 5 instead
entries.zh: 更改了客户端自动模式分类器，以忽略命名 Claude Sonnet 5.5 或 Opus 5.5 的`ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL`引脚，并改用 Claude Sonnet 5

entries.en: Changed `claude project purge` to `claude purge`; the old name still works and prints a notice
entries.zh: 将“克劳德项目清除”更改为“克劳德清除”；旧名称仍然有效并打印通知

entries.en: Changed the agents view `n:` filter (and Ctrl+F search) so Enter opens the session whose name matches best instead of the top row
entries.zh: 更改了代理视图`n:`过滤器（和 Ctrl+F 搜索），以便按 Enter 键打开名称最匹配的会话，而不是顶行

entries.en: Changed `/autocompact` to save the auto-compact window per model, so each model keeps its own setting when you switch
entries.zh: 更改了`/autocompact`以保存每个模型的自动压缩窗口，因此当您切换时每个模型都会保留自己的设置

entries.en: Changed MCP URL prompts from servers that can't report when you're done to wait for "I'm done, continue" before the tool call continues, so you can finish in the browser first
entries.zh: 更改了无法报告完成时间的服务器的 MCP URL 提示，以便在工具调用继续之前等待“我完成了，继续”，以便您可以先在浏览器中完成

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved Claude to also follow a related Slack thread in another channel that it only read, so updates there reach the conversation that depends on them
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进 Claude：对于它只读过的另一个频道中的相关 Slack 话题，也会跟进，使那里的更新能传达给依赖它们的对话

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved save errors on a channel's Configure page: too-long channel instructions now say to shorten them, and a save refused for lost access no longer says to try again
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进频道配置页面的保存错误提示：频道指令过长时会提示缩短，因失去访问权限而被拒绝的保存不再提示你重试

entries.en: Fixed mid-response API timeouts failing the turn: non-interactive sessions and subagents now continue from the partial response, and thinking-only responses are retried
entries.zh: 修复了中间响应 API 超时失败的问题：非交互式会话和子代理现在从部分响应继续，并且仅重试仅思考响应

entries.en: Fixed long conversations failing with "Prompt is too long" instead of auto-compacting when the last reply reported zero token usage
entries.zh: 修复了当最后一个回复报告零令牌使用时，长对话失败并显示“提示太长”而不是自动压缩的问题

entries.en: Fixed `--resume` sometimes dropping files and other context that a compaction had just restored
entries.zh: 修复了`--resume`有时会删除压缩刚刚恢复的文件和其他上下文的问题

entries.en: Fixed a resumed session sometimes not saving the last response of a turn, so that the next `--resume` showed the prompt unanswered
entries.zh: 修复了恢复的会话有时不保存回合的最后一个响应，以便下一个`--resume`显示未应答的提示

entries.en: Fixed resume occasionally loading a transcript cut short when the same session rewrote the file during the load
entries.zh: 修复了当同一会话在加载期间重写文件时，简历偶尔加载记录会被缩短的问题

entries.en: Fixed resuming a conversation started on 2.1.286 or earlier dropping the model's earlier thinking
entries.zh: 修复了恢复从 2.1.286 或更早版本开始的对话，从而放弃模型的早期思考

entries.en: Fixed session titles, memory recall and prompt hooks failing on Mantle or behind gateways that reject structured outputs; added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_STRUCTURED_OUTPUTS` to turn structured outputs off
entries.zh: 修复了 Mantle 上或拒绝结构化输出的网关后面的会话标题、记忆调用和提示挂钩失败的问题；添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_STRUCTURED_OUTPUTS`以关闭结构化输出

entries.en: Fixed auto mode denials pointing Claude at a Bash permission rule when the blocked tool was not Bash
entries.zh: 修复了当被阻止的工具不是 Bash 时自动模式拒绝将 Claude 指向 Bash 权限规则的问题

entries.en: Fixed auto mode on Bedrock and Mantle switching to the local classifier for the rest of the session after a request to an older model, such as a WebFetch summary or a `sonnet` subagent
entries.zh: 修复了在请求旧模型（例如 WebFetch 摘要或`sonnet`子代理）后，Bedrock 和 Mantle 上的自动模式切换到本地分类器以进行会话的其余部分

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions that restarted on a newly picked model replying with that model after the server refused it
entries.zh: 修复了在服务器拒绝后在新选择的模型上重新启动并回复该模型的云会话

entries.en: Fixed Cowork cloud sessions staying marked as waiting for input after a WebFetch permission prompt for an unapproved URL went unanswered for five minutes
entries.zh: 修复了在未批准 URL 的 WebFetch 权限提示五分钟内无人应答后，Cowork 云会话仍标记为等待输入的问题

entries.en: Fixed prompt suggestions not appearing on a phone that joins a Cowork cloud session started on another device
entries.zh: 修复了加入在另一台设备上启动的 Cowork 云会话的手机上未出现提示建议的问题

entries.en: Fixed a mod's button sometimes running a different button's action when pressed on a view drawn before Claude Code restarted
entries.zh: 修复了在克劳德代码重新启动之前绘制的视图上按下时，mod 的按钮有时会运行不同按钮的操作

entries.en: Fixed a plugin's pane showing nothing when one `Code` element held a diff that does not parse; it now draws as plain code
entries.zh: 修复了当一个`Code`元素包含无法解析的差异时插件窗格不显示任何内容的问题；它现在绘制为纯代码

entries.en: Fixed plugin LSP servers receiving literal `${user_config.*}` and `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` placeholders in `initializationOptions` and `settings` instead of substituted values or manifest defaults
entries.zh: 修复了插件 LSP 服务器在`initializationOptions`和`settings`中接收文字`${user_config.*}`和`${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}`占位符，而不是替换值或清单默认值

entries.en: Fixed a plugin's `tool.call` hook making Bash fail and file searches read the wrong folder in subagents that run in a worktree
entries.zh: 修复了插件的`tool.call`钩子导致 Bash 失败并且文件搜索读取工作树中运行的子代理中的错误文件夹

entries.en: Fixed `git-subdir` plugin installs failing, or caching an incomplete plugin, on older git (before 2.39, e.g. Ubuntu 22.04's 2.34)
entries.zh: 修复了旧版 git 上`git-subdir`插件安装失败或缓存不完整插件的问题（2.39 之前的版本，例如 Ubuntu 22.04 的 2.34）

entries.en: Fixed plugins loaded with `--plugin-dir` not showing "Configure options" in `/plugin`
entries.zh: 修复了使用 `--plugin-dir` 加载的插件未在 `/plugin` 中显示“配置选项”

entries.en: Fixed background sessions ending when a plugin was reloaded or disabled while one of its timers or reads was still running
entries.zh: 修复了当插件重新加载或禁用而其计时器或读取之一仍在运行时后台会话结束的问题

entries.en: Fixed sandboxed heredocs with an unquoted delimiter (`python3 <<EOF`) asking for approval on every run under sandbox auto-allow when the body holds only plain text and simple `$VAR` references
entries.zh: 修复了带有不带引号的分隔符 (`python3 <<EOF`) 的沙盒文档，当主体仅包含纯文本和简单的 `$VAR` 引用时，要求沙盒自动允许下的每次运行都获得批准

entries.en: Fixed Bash tool permission check to prompt before a `BASHPID` assignment whose value the shell would evaluate as arithmetic, instead of allowing it silently
entries.zh: 修复了 Bash 工具权限检查，以在`BASHPID`分配之前进行提示，shell 会将其值评估为算术值，而不是默默地允许它

entries.en: Fixed fullscreen sessions exiting with "unrecoverable interface error" when opening the background tasks dialog while a plugin or mod showed rows above the prompt
entries.zh: 修复了当插件或 mod 在提示上方显示行时打开后台任务对话框时，全屏会话因“不可恢复的界面错误”而退出的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude reporting a message to another session as delivered when that session held it: the notice now says it wasn't delivered and names the session, and in SDK sessions Claude can now learn of it mid-turn
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude 将消息报告给另一个会话时该会话持有该消息时已传递的问题：通知现在显示该消息未传递并命名该会话，并且在 SDK 会话中 Claude 现在可以在中途了解该消息

entries.en: Fixed OpenTelemetry `claude_code.tool.blocked_on_user` spans reporting `unknown` source or decision in `-p` and SDK sessions and for PreToolUse hook approvals
entries.zh: 修复了 OpenTelemetry`claude_code.tool.blocked_on_user`在`-p`和 SDK 会话以及 PreToolUse 挂钩批准中报告“未知”来源或决策的问题

entries.en: Fixed permission asks that ended unanswered, in `-p` or on an interrupted turn, emitting no `tool_decision` event
entries.zh: 修复了在`-p`中或在中断的回合中未得到答复而结束的权限请求，不发出`tool_decision`事件

entries.en: Fixed Edit and Retry in Cowork cloud sessions refusing a message sent before `/compact` even though its history was still saved
entries.zh: 修复了 Cowork 云会话中的编辑和重试拒绝在`/compact`之前发送的消息，即使其历史记录仍被保存

entries.en: Fixed unattended sessions (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`) retrying for hours after a very long response stream failed; Claude Code now streams again, and gives up after three timeouts
entries.zh: 修复无人值守会话（`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`）在超长响应流失败后会重试数小时的问题；现在 Claude Code 会重新流式输出，并在三次超时后放弃

entries.en: Fixed `/login` reporting "Login successful" when credentials could not be saved to secure storage; it now shows the failure, and offers a retry when the new login didn't take effect (anthropics/claude-code#73861)
entries.zh: 修复了当凭证无法保存到安全存储时`/login`报告“登录成功”的问题；它现在显示失败，并在新登录未生效时提供重试（anthropics/claude-code#73861）

entries.en: Fixed a Stop during Bedrock credential lookup sometimes moving the session to a fallback model instead of ending the request
entries.zh: 修复了基岩凭证查找期间的停止有时会将会话移动到后备模型而不是结束请求

entries.en: Fixed a second `gcpAuthRefresh`/`awsAuthRefresh` browser sign-in opening when a laptop wakes from sleep while another Claude Code process is signing in
entries.zh: 修复了当笔记本电脑从睡眠状态唤醒而另一个 Claude Code 进程正在登录时，第二个`gcpAuthRefresh`/`awsAuthRefresh`浏览器登录打开的问题

entries.en: Fixed agent teams: a plugin-defined agent spawned by name now runs with its own prompt, tools, disallowedTools and effort instead of the defaults
entries.zh: 修复了代理团队：按名称生成的插件定义代理现在使用自己的提示、工具、disallowedTools 和工作量运行，而不是默认值

entries.en: Fixed headless (`-p` / SDK) sessions occasionally ignoring SIGTERM when a supervisor such as `timeout` or systemd sends SIGCONT alongside it
entries.zh: 修复了当`timeout`或 systemd 等监督者同时发送 SIGCONT 时，无头（`-p`/SDK）会话偶尔会忽略 SIGTERM

entries.en: Fixed restarted cloud sessions restoring a model that the organization's enforced model list refuses
entries.zh: 修复了重新启动的云会话恢复组织强制模型列表拒绝的模型

entries.en: Fixed MCP tool calls sometimes running twice when a remote server's result was over 16 MB or could not be parsed
entries.zh: 修复了当远程服务器的结果超过 16 MB 或无法解析时，MCP 工具调用有时会运行两次的问题

entries.en: Fixed subagents in Claude Desktop's Code tab getting none of the tools of a user-configured MCP server named `memory`
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude Desktop 的“代码”选项卡中的子代理无法获取用户配置的名为“内存”的 MCP 服务器的任何工具的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude in Chrome asking before every screenshot and page read on a site you allowed when auto mode is unavailable (such as with `disableAutoMode` or an older model); typing, navigation and JavaScript still ask
entries.zh: 修复了当自动模式不可用时（例如使用`disableAutoMode`或旧型号）时，Chrome 中的 Claude 在您允许的网站上读取每个屏幕截图和页面之前询问的问题；打字、导航和 JavaScript 仍然有问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin install` failing for GitHub-source plugins on macOS and Linux machines with no GitHub SSH key: the clone now falls back to HTTPS and prints a notice
entries.zh: 修复了在没有 GitHub SSH 密钥的 macOS 和 Linux 计算机上 GitHub 源插件安装失败的问题：克隆现在回退到 HTTPS 并打印通知

entries.en: Fixed `sandbox.credentials.files` entries on git config files not taking effect while `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` is on
entries.zh: 修复了 git 配置文件中的`sandbox.credentials.files`条目在`permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories`打开时不生效的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude leaving out your organization's design systems when starting slides or a design with the Artifact tool on Team and Enterprise plans or machines with managed settings
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德在使用团队和企业计划或具有托管设置的机器上的 Artifact 工具启动幻灯片或设计时遗漏了组织的设计系统的问题

entries.en: Fixed the keyboard not working on Windows after Claude Code restarts itself (first sign-in to a Claude apps gateway, provider setup, `/tui`)
entries.zh: 修复 Claude Code 自行重启后（如首次登录 Claude 应用网关、服务商设置、`/tui`），Windows 上键盘失效的问题

entries.en: Fixed a stall when launching an agent whose `tools:` lists very many `Agent(...)` entries
entries.zh: 修复了启动“工具：”列出大量`Agent(...)`条目的代理时出现的停顿

entries.en: Fixed sessions on Claude 3 Opus and Claude 3 Sonnet failing on every turn after a whole PDF entered the conversation
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude 3 Opus 和 Claude 3 Sonnet 上的会话在整个 PDF 进入对话后每次都会失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed the npm auto-updater reporting success when the platform-native binary failed to download and only the placeholder `claude` stub was installed
entries.zh: 修复 npm 自动更新程序在原生二进制下载失败、只安装了占位 `claude` 存根时仍报告成功的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control cleanup archiving a session that is still connected or was just re-attached by another Claude Code process
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制清理归档仍处于连接状态或刚刚被另一个 Claude Code 进程重新附加的会话的问题

entries.en: Fixed `owner/repo` plugin marketplaces showing only the second attempt's error when both the SSH and HTTPS fetch fail; both errors are now shown, with the transport tried first on top
entries.zh: 修复了当 SSH 和 HTTPS 获取失败时`owner/repo`插件市场仅显示第二次尝试的错误；现在显示了两个错误，首先尝试的传输位于顶部

entries.en: Fixed path-scoped `.claude/rules` and nested CLAUDE.md files not loading when Write or Edit creates or changes a file in their scope (previously only Read loaded them)
entries.zh: 修复了当“写入”或“编辑”在其范围内创建或更改文件时，路径范围的`.claude/rules`和嵌套的 CLAUDE.md 文件不会加载（以前只能读取加载它们）

entries.en: Fixed a dangerous `rm` (such as one on `/` or the home directory) inside a `bash -c` or `sh -c` script running without a prompt in bypassPermissions mode or under a shell allow rule (anthropics/claude-code#96300)
entries.zh: 修复了`bash -c`或`sh -c`脚本中危险的`rm`（例如`/`或主目录上的一个），在bypassPermissions模式下或在shell允许规则下没有提示的情况下运行（anthropics/claude-code#96300）

entries.en: Fixed LSP tool calls hanging indefinitely when a language server uses dynamic capability registration or stops responding; requests now time out after 60s (per-server `requestTimeout`)
entries.zh: 修复了语言服务器使用动态能力注册或停止响应时 LSP 工具调用无限期挂起的问题；现在请求会在 60 秒后超时（每个服务器`requestTimeout`）

entries.en: Fixed `idle_prompt` notification hooks firing while background agents are still running (anthropics/claude-code#93672)
entries.zh: 修复了后台代理仍在运行时触发的`idle_prompt`通知挂钩（anthropics/claude-code#93672）

entries.en: Fixed PreToolUse and PermissionRequest hooks being skipped when matching them failed or the tool's input could not be serialized to JSON; the call is now blocked
entries.zh: 修复了 PreToolUse 和 PermissionRequest 钩子在匹配失败或工具的输入无法序列化为 JSON 时被跳过的问题；呼叫现已被阻止

entries.en: Fixed the first request in a fresh environment or after a model switch using the built-in output limit and auto-compact window, not the server's; that request may now wait up to 1.5 seconds
entries.zh: 修复全新环境中或切换模型后的第一个请求，使用的是内置输出上限和自动压缩窗口，而非服务器下发的值的问题；现在该请求可能最多等待 1.5 秒

entries.en: Fixed the "What should Claude do instead?" hint showing on the Interrupted row after sending queued messages with ctrl+enter
entries.zh: 修正了“克劳德应该做什么？”使用 ctrl+enter 发送排队消息后，提示显示在中断行上

entries.en: Fixed `/login` in a `--bare` session running a sign-in the session never reads, which could replace your saved login; it now says which credentials work
entries.zh: 修复了运行登录的`--bare`会话中的`/login`，该会话永远不会读取，这可能会替换您保存的登录信息；现在它会说明哪些凭据有效

entries.en: Fixed the InstructionsLoaded hook omitting agent_id and agent_type when a subagent's file access loads a rule or nested CLAUDE.md; rules and nested CLAUDE.md files loaded on file access now also report effort
entries.zh: 修复子智能体访问文件加载规则或嵌套 CLAUDE.md 时，InstructionsLoaded 钩子漏掉 agent_id 和 agent_type 的问题；现在按文件访问加载的规则和嵌套 CLAUDE.md 也会上报 effort

entries.en: Fixed the Agent tool in `claude mcp serve` always reporting no available agents and rejecting every subagent_type
entries.zh: 修复了“claude mcpserve”中的代理工具始终报告没有可用代理并拒绝每个 subagent_type

entries.en: Fixed the terminal cursor not following the typed text in the fullscreen transcript viewer's search and in `/theme`'s custom color search
entries.zh: 修复全屏转录查看器的搜索和 `/theme` 的自定义颜色搜索中，终端光标不跟随输入文字的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/permissions` in screen reader mode: typing a rule's number now picks it instead of opening the search box
entries.zh: 修复了屏幕阅读器模式下的`/permissions`：现在输入规则编号即可选择它，而不是打开搜索框

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a claude.ai connector staying on "Needs authentication" after you authorize it: the MCP servers dialog now offers Check connection
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复 claude.ai 连接器授权后仍显示 "Needs authentication" 的问题：MCP 服务器对话框现在提供 Check connection 选项

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the opt-in New Conversation shortcut (Cmd/Ctrl+N) starting a conversation in every visible Claude view instead of only the one you are in
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复可选的 New Conversation 快捷键（Cmd/Ctrl+N）会在所有可见的 Claude 视图中各开始一个对话、而不是只在当前视图中开始的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the chat view resuming the next saved session after you archive the one it shows; it now starts a new conversation instead
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复归档当前显示的会话后，聊天视图会恢复到下一个已保存会话的问题；现在改为开始新对话

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed the Cloud sessions switch in Claude Code admin settings staying locked off while an unrelated security setting was loading or had failed to load
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复无关的安全设置加载中或加载失败时，Claude Code 管理设置中的云端会话开关一直锁定关闭的问题

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed pressing Stop while a self-hosted runner was still starting not cancelling the queued message, which could then run once the runner was up
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复自托管运行器仍在启动时按下 Stop，排队中的消息没有取消、运行器启动后仍会执行的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag admin settings offering a "Remove this scope" option, which always failed, on channels whose settings were created automatically
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Claude Tag 管理设置在自动创建设置的频道上，显示总是失败的「Remove this scope」选项的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin test` reporting mods as turned off remotely when it had only read an out-of-date saved setting
entries.zh: 修复了“克劳德插件测试”报告模块在仅读取过时的保存设置时远程关闭的问题
